verdict.line: You lose if you trade into her Bladesurge (Q) reset chains and let Ionian Fervor stack to 5; you win if you survive to your Trinity Force spike and only commit R (Hextech Ultimatum) when she's already spent E (Flawless Duet) or R (Vanguard's Edge).

brief.thesis: Irelia's kit is built to punish standing still: Bladesurge (Q) refreshes its full cooldown for free whenever the target is Marked or dies to it, so a low-HP minion near you is a free dash, and Ionian Fervor stacks bonus attack speed off every spell hit until she's adding flat on-hit damage at 5 stacks. Camille has no ranged answer to this — Hookshot (E) only functions near a wall, and Hextech Ultimatum (R) doesn't exist until level 6 and sits on a 140/115/90s cooldown even then. That structural gap is why the measured data has Irelia holding both the lane and solo-kill advantage at a 46.2% Camille win rate over 455 games — play this lane to survive to your spike, not to force it.

theirWindow.when: minions near death, or 5 passive stacks
theirWindow.what: A dying minion next to you is a free Bladesurge (Q) reset that closes the gap without costing her the real cooldown — don't let one sit between you. If she's also at 5 Ionian Fervor stacks, her next few autos carry bonus on-hit damage, so disengage rather than trade through it.

yourWindow.when: when her E (Flawless Duet) is down
yourWindow.what: Without Flawless Duet up she has no stun to punish a commitment, so this is when to step forward with Q (Precision Protocol) and W (Tactical Sweep) for poke. If she opens with E or R (Vanguard's Edge) anyway, answer immediately with R (Hextech Ultimatum) so the anchor and bonus magic damage land before she can follow up.

start.why: Highest win rate and pick rate start (48.5% over 443 games, 81% pick) — the extra AD gives you real damage to punish Bladesurge (Q) whiffs and short cooldown windows instead of just surviving poke.

boots.why: 47.4% win rate and 86% pick — Irelia's damage comes almost entirely from basic attacks (Ionian Fervor on-hit, Bladesurge dash-attack), so flat physical damage reduction directly counters her stacked passive.

Completes the top win-rate path — damage mitigation lets you survive the burst window when she's at 5 passive stacks.

runes.keystoneWhy: Matches the defensive shape of this matchup (46.5% win rate, 29% pick, the more common page here) — permanent max-HP growth and sustain from proc'ing autos helps you survive to your item spike rather than win a damage race you don't have early.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest win rate (46.6%) and dominant pick (70.8%) — Ignite punishes her Bladesurge (Q) sustain directly and Flash covers the fact you have no ranged engage or escape until Hookshot (E) is available near a wall.

playing.title: Don't feed her Q resets
playing.detail: Bladesurge (Q) refreshes its entire 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown if the target is Marked or dies to it — protect low-HP minions near you rather than letting her cash one in to dash onto you for free.

playing.title: Track her passive to 5 stacks
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor grants stacking attack speed on every spell hit and flat bonus on-hit damage at max stacks — disengage before a trade lets her reach 5, per the danger threshold in this matchup.

playing.title: Never trade into a charging W
playing.detail: Defiant Dance (W) reduces the physical damage she takes while charging — landing your Q (Precision Protocol) auto mid-charge wastes it, so wait for the release or bait it early.

playing.title: Save R for her E or R
playing.detail: Hextech Ultimatum (R) dashes to and anchors her at 475 range — commit it the moment she opens with Flawless Duet (E) or Vanguard's Edge (R) so her stun or Mark doesn't go unanswered.

playing.title: Only use Hookshot near a wall
playing.detail: Hookshot (E) needs a wall to pull to before it knocks up on landing — plan your engages and resets around lane terrain, since without one it's just a short leap with no knockup.

playing.title: Delay your Q recast for full value
playing.detail: Precision Protocol (Q) can be recast for significantly more bonus damage if you wait between the two attacks — hold the second hit instead of firing it immediately when you need max trade damage.

playing.title: Auto before you expect physical damage
playing.detail: Adaptive Defenses grants a shield versus the damage type of whoever you just basic-attacked — land an auto on her right before an expected physical trade so the shield against her damage is already active.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning for why those numbers hold — the Q reset pattern, passive stack thresholds, and cooldown-timed windows — is this brief's own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Irelia closing in by using minions low on health! Fighting Irelia is dangerous when she has 5 (P) stacks up. Try absorbing Irelia’s ultimate or (E) with Camille’s [R].
